classes.name: IntRes2d_Domain
classes.summary:
Definition of the domain of parameter on a 2d-curve. Most of the time, a domain is defined by two extremities. An extremity is made of :
- a point in 2d-space (Pnt2d from gp),
- a parameter on the curve,
- a tolerance in the 2d-space. Sometimes, it can be made of 0 or 1 point ( for an infinite or semi-infinite line for example).
For Intersection algorithms, Ellipses and Circles Domains must be closed. So, SetEquivalentParameters(.,.) method must be called after initializing the first and the last bounds.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates an infinite Domain (HasFirstPoint = False and HasLastPoint = False).

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (Pnt: gp_Pnt2d, Par: number, Tol: number, First: boolean)
constructors.comment: Creates a semi-infinite Domain. If First is set to True, the given point is the first point of the domain, otherwise it is the last point.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (Pnt1: gp_Pnt2d, Par1: number, Tol1: number, Pnt2: gp_Pnt2d, Par2: number, Tol2: number)

instanceMethods.signature: (Pnt1: gp_Pnt2d, Par1: number, Tol1: number, Pnt2: gp_Pnt2d, Par2: number, Tol2: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the values for a bounded domain.

instanceMethods.name: SetValues
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the values for an infinite domain.

instanceMethods.name: SetValues
instanceMethods.signature: (Pnt: gp_Pnt2d, Par: number, Tol: number, First: boolean): void
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the values for a semi-infinite domain.

instanceMethods.name: SetEquivalentParameters
instanceMethods.comment: Defines a closed domain.

instanceMethods.name: HasFirstPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the domain has a first point, i-e a point defining the lowest admitted parameter on the curve.

instanceMethods.name: FirstParameter
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the parameter of the first point of the domain The exception DomainError is raised if HasFirstPoint returns False.

instanceMethods.name: FirstPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the first point of the domain. The exception DomainError is raised if HasFirstPoint returns False.

instanceMethods.name: FirstTolerance
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the tolerance of the first (left) bound. The exception DomainError is raised if HasFirstPoint returns False.

instanceMethods.name: HasLastPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the domain has a last point, i-e a point defining the highest admitted parameter on the curve.

instanceMethods.name: LastParameter
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the parameter of the last point of the domain. The exception DomainError is raised if HasLastPoint returns False.

instanceMethods.name: LastPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the last point of the domain. The exception DomainError is raised if HasLastPoint returns False.

instanceMethods.name: LastTolerance
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the tolerance of the last (right) bound. The exception DomainError is raised if HasLastPoint returns False.

instanceMethods.name: IsClosed
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the domain is closed.

instanceMethods.name: EquivalentParameters
instanceMethods.signature: (zero: number, zeroplusperiod: number): { zero: number; zeroplusperiod: number }
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns Equivalent parameters if the domain is closed. Otherwise, the exception DomainError is raised.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `zero`: updated value from the call.
- `zeroplusperiod`: updated value from the call.

classes.name: IntRes2d_Intersection
classes.summary: Defines the root class of all the Intersections between two 2D-Curves, and provides all the methods about the results of the Intersections Algorithms.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: returns TRUE when the computation was successful.

instanceMethods.name: IsEmpty
instanceMethods.comment: Returns TRUE if there is no intersection between the given arguments. The exception NotDone is raised if IsDone returns FALSE.

instanceMethods.name: NbPoints
instanceMethods.comment: This function returns the number of intersection points between the 2 curves. The exception NotDone is raised if IsDone returns FALSE.

instanceMethods.name: Point
instanceMethods.comment: This function returns the intersection point of range N; The exception NotDone is raised if IsDone returns FALSE. The exception OutOfRange is raised if (N <= 0) or (N > NbPoints).

instanceMethods.name: NbSegments
instanceMethods.comment: This function returns the number of intersection segments between the two curves. The exception NotDone is raised if IsDone returns FALSE.

instanceMethods.name: Segment
instanceMethods.comment: This function returns the intersection segment of range N; The exception NotDone is raised if IsDone returns FALSE. The exception OutOfRange is raised if (N <= 0) or (N > NbPoints).

classes.name: IntRes2d_IntersectionPoint
classes.summary: Definition of an intersection point between two 2D curves.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (P: gp_Pnt2d, Uc1: number, Uc2: number, Trans1: IntRes2d_Transition, Trans2: IntRes2d_Transition, ReversedFlag: boolean)
constructors.comment: Creates an IntersectionPoint. if ReversedFlag is False, the parameter Uc1(resp. Uc2) and the Transition Trans1 (resp. Trans2) refer to the first curve (resp. second curve) otherwise Uc1 and Trans1 (resp. Uc2 and Trans2) refer to the second curve (resp. the first curve).

instanceMethods.name: SetValues
instanceMethods.signature: (P: gp_Pnt2d, Uc1: number, Uc2: number, Trans1: IntRes2d_Transition, Trans2: IntRes2d_Transition, ReversedFlag: boolean): void
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the values for an existing intersection point. The meaning of the parameters are the same as for the Create.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of the coordinates of the intersection point in the 2D space.

instanceMethods.name: ParamOnFirst
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the parameter on the first curve.

instanceMethods.name: ParamOnSecond
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the parameter on the second curve.

instanceMethods.name: TransitionOfFirst
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the transition of the 1st curve compared to the 2nd one.

instanceMethods.name: TransitionOfSecond
instanceMethods.comment: returns the transition of the 2nd curve compared to the 1st one.

classes.name: IntRes2d_IntersectionSegment
classes.summary: Definition of an intersection curve between two 2D curves.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates an infinite segment of intersection.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (P1: IntRes2d_IntersectionPoint, P2: IntRes2d_IntersectionPoint, Oppos: boolean, ReverseFlag: boolean)

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (P: IntRes2d_IntersectionPoint, First: boolean, Oppos: boolean, ReverseFlag: boolean)

instanceMethods.name: IsOpposite
instanceMethods.comment: Returns FALSE if the intersection segment has got the same orientation on both curves.

instanceMethods.name: HasFirstPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the segment is limited by a first point. This point defines the lowest parameter admitted on the first curve for the segment. If IsOpposite returns False, it defines the lowest parameter on the second curve, otherwise, it is the highest parameter on the second curve.

instanceMethods.name: FirstPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the first point of the segment as an IntersectionPoint (with a transition). The exception DomainError is raised if HasFirstPoint returns False.

instanceMethods.name: HasLastPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the segment is limited by a last point. This point defines the highest parameter admitted on the first curve for the segment. If IsOpposite returns False, it defines the highest parameter on the second curve, otherwise, it is the lowest parameter on the second curve.

instanceMethods.name: LastPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the last point of the segment as an IntersectionPoint (with a transition). The exception DomainError is raised if HasLastExtremity returns False.

classes.name: IntRes2d_Transition
classes.summary: Definition of the type of transition near an intersection point between two curves. The transition is either a "true transition", which means that one of the curves goes inside or outside the area defined by the other curve near the intersection, or a "touch transition" which means that the first curve does not cross the other one, or an "undecided" transition, which means that the curves are superposed.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates an IN or OUT transition.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (Tangent: boolean, Pos: IntRes2d_Position, Situ: IntRes2d_Situation, Oppos: boolean)

instanceMethods.name: SetValue
instanceMethods.signature: (Tangent: boolean, Pos: IntRes2d_Position, Type: IntRes2d_TypeTrans): void
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the values of an IN or OUT transition.

instanceMethods.name: SetValue
instanceMethods.signature: (Tangent: boolean, Pos: IntRes2d_Position, Situ: IntRes2d_Situation, Oppos: boolean): void
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the values of a TOUCH transition.

instanceMethods.name: SetValue
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the values of an UNDECIDED transition.

instanceMethods.name: SetPosition
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the value of the position.

instanceMethods.name: PositionOnCurve
instanceMethods.comment: Indicates if the intersection is at the beginning (IntRes2d_Head), at the end (IntRes2d_End), or in the middle (IntRes2d_Middle) of the curve.

instanceMethods.name: TransitionType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the type of transition at the intersection. It may be IN or OUT or TOUCH, or UNDECIDED if the two first derivatives are not enough to give the tangent to one of the two curves.

instanceMethods.name: IsTangent
instanceMethods.comment: Returns TRUE when the 2 curves are tangent at the intersection point. Theexception DomainError is raised if the type of transition is UNDECIDED.

instanceMethods.name: Situation
instanceMethods.comment: returns a significant value if TransitionType returns TOUCH. In this case, the function returns : INSIDE when the curve remains inside the other one, OUTSIDE when it remains outside the other one, UNKNOWN when the calculus, based on the second derivatives cannot give the result. If TransitionType returns IN or OUT or UNDECIDED, the exception DomainError is raised.

instanceMethods.name: IsOpposite
instanceMethods.comment: returns a significant value if TransitionType returns TOUCH. In this case, the function returns true when the 2 curves locally define two different parts of the space. If TransitionType returns IN or OUT or UNDECIDED, the exception DomainError is raised.
